run_func_step: run a Func step that wraps a Python function and executes it with input arguments
detect_generator_function: detect whether a wrapped function has no required parameters and acts as a generator
resolve_input_param: auto-resolve the single required input parameter name from a function signature
serialize_func_step: serialize a Func step to JSON and restore it via Step model validation
chain_func_steps: chain multiple Func steps together in a Chain with optional caching infrastructure
